title: Speed round
instructions: 10 seconds per question. Keys: 1 = true, 2 = false.

questions.statement: Rolling update is the default strategy in Kubernetes.
Blue-green needs double resources for a while.
A feature flag turns a feature on or off without a deployment.
Deploy and release mean the same thing.
questions.explanation: Deploy: the code runs in production. Release: users get the feature. Flags separate the two.

questions.statement: The longer a branch lives, the easier the merge.
In the sample pipeline, a pull request runs only the tests; a merge to main also builds and pushes the image.
.gitignore is where you list secrets you want Git to encrypt.
questions.explanation: .gitignore lists files Git should not track at all. Secrets should never be committed.
